scope: Live-state canonical enrichment discovered after the Batch 482 handoff checkpoint; this pass predates Batch 484 and is recorded for continuity rather than re-researching the same eight records.

selected.mechanics_notes: Evasive counter that freezes attackers on contact; 300 Stamina; PQ96 “The Shadow Dragons.”
100 Stamina? Actually this is a 100-Ki Other Super. It creates afterimages and can be interrupted or followed with another attack; PQ81 “Wake Up!”.
300 Ki Blast Ultimate; large explosion, base 40% over 13 hits and extendable by holding the input to spend additional Ki; Expert Mission 12.

500-Ki Awoken. Grants +30% all-attack damage, +20% Ki restoration and -20% damage taken? The current DBXV2 page lists damage taken increased by 20%; the modifier table represents -20% defense. It also adds the H-L-H-H-H-H-H combo and teleports on standing Light/charged Heavy. Unlocked through Gohan/Videl and Piccolo friendship/training.
100 Ki Blast Super; fire Kamehameha, then press the input again to make the beam track the target; Skill Shop.
300 Ki Blast Ultimate; chargeable beam that fires a second wave on hit, with charging increasing damage/hits; PQ148 “Finding Out About Fusion.”
100 Ki Other Super; deals no damage and drains the opponent’s Ki from the front, with charge increasing the drain; PQ94 “Ultimate Power, Ultimate Saiyan.”
Other Super charge skill; starts charging very quickly then slows down, making short bursts particularly useful; PQ134 “Universe 7’s Next God of Destruction.”
